about_the_game:
After the wealthy elite abandon a climate decimated earth, the remnants of human society focus their last hope on their newly discovered "Quantum Canon" technology.

After stockpiling years of energy, they are ready to send a single augmented-human explorer to a seemingly uninhabited, distant living-world dubbed "New Pangea". They hope that in this new frontier they can build the "Quantum Gate Terminus" that will allow humanity to flee the dying Earth.

The Explorers job is simple: Without Tools or Resources, Naked and Alone (Except for your helpful ocular mounted AI companion "ALAI"):

  • Explore this new world and learn it's secrets and history.

  • Survive privation and isolation of the eerily familiar planet.

  • Build your way from stone age technology to height of technology.

  • Learn from previous failed "Quantum Gate Jumps" by retaining upgrades and perks.

name: Remnant Frontier: Survival

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: The Remnants of humanity send an augmented human to a seemingly uninhabited alien frontier. From sticks and stones, build the tools required to complete the Quantum Gate Terminus and save the world. A relaxed yet deep and engaging Rogue-lite Card Based Adventure; Combine, Explore, Learn & Build.
